name: pglet
description: pglet's development root, never published: the npm package is assembled in crates/pglet_wasm/pkg-npm

scripts.check: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm run check:stripped && npm run check:wasm-features && cargo fmt --check && npm run check:docs && npm run check:ts && npm run check:release
scripts.check:wasm-features: cargo clippy -p pglet -p pglet_wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features pglet_wasm/default -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p pglet -p pglet_wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p pglet -p pglet_wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features pglet_wasm/default,pglet_wasm/opfs -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p pglet_wasm --all-targets --features opfs -- -D warnings
scripts.check:docs: RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links -D rustdoc::invalid_html_tags' cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --document-private-items --features pglet_wasm/opfs
scripts.size:gzip: cargo build --release -p pglet_server && gzip -c target/release/pglet_server | wc -c
scripts.test:wasm: npm run wasm:build && tsc -p tests-web/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config tests-web/vitest.config.ts tests-web/integration/pglet_wasm_test.ts
scripts.wasm:build:opfs: wasm-pack build crates/pglet_wasm --target web --out-dir pkg-opfs --features opfs
scripts.build:npm: rm -rf crates/pglet_wasm/pkg-npm && wasm-pack build crates/pglet_wasm --target web --scope fuzdev --out-dir pkg-npm && gro task src/tasks/patch_npm_package.task.ts
scripts.test:web: npm run test:integration && npm run test:drizzle && npm run test:kysely && npm run test:postgres && npm run test:pg && npm run test:npm
scripts.test:integration: cargo build -p pglet_server && tsc -p tests-web/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config tests-web/vitest.config.ts tests-web/integration/pglet_test.ts
scripts.test:integration:server: cargo build -p pglet_server && tsc -p tests-web/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config tests-web/vitest.config.ts tests-web/integration/server_test.ts
scripts.test:drizzle: cargo build -p pglet_server && tsc -p tests-web/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config tests-web/vitest.config.ts tests-web/orms/drizzle/drizzle_test.ts
scripts.test:kysely: cargo build -p pglet_server && tsc -p tests-web/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config tests-web/vitest.config.ts tests-web/orms/kysely/kysely_test.ts
scripts.test:postgres: cargo build -p pglet_server && tsc -p tests-web/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config tests-web/vitest.config.ts tests-web/drivers/postgres/postgres_test.ts
scripts.test:pg: cargo build -p pglet_server && tsc -p tests-web/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config tests-web/vitest.config.ts tests-web/drivers/pg/pg_test.ts
scripts.test:npm: npm run build:npm && tsc -p tests-web/npm/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config tests-web/vitest.config.ts tests-web/npm/ && node --test scripts/test_npm_node.mjs scripts/test_npm_pack.mjs
scripts.test:npm:node: npm run build:npm && node --test scripts/test_npm_node.mjs scripts/test_npm_pack.mjs
scripts.matrix:artifacts: cargo build --release -p pglet_server && npm run build:npm && npm run --silent matrix:env
